result.summary: Found 1 major content issue: a duplicate restaurant card appears in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' restaurant card is duplicated in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, displaying two identical cards side by side with the same image, delivery time ('15-25 min'), and delivery fee ('€0.90 delivery').
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate the items returned or rendered in the 'Fastest near you' carousel so each restaurant appears only once.
